title: Timber retaining walls: producer statement from a non-CPEng designer (Pyes Pa, Tauranga)
jurisdiction: New Zealand (MBIE, Building Act 2004): comparative test only; not an Alberta case; no Alberta applicability asserted
document_type: MBIE determination under Building Act 2004 s188 (regulator decision on an individual matter); not an applicant's alternative-solution file

facts.text: Application for two types of timber retaining wall with a safety barrier included a producer statement design (PS1) prepared by a person who was not a registered Chartered Professional Engineer (CPEng).
Authority policy: it no longer accepts a PS2 review signed by a CPEng supporting specifically designed elements produced by an engineer who is not a CPEng.
No evidence the walls fail the Building Code; the matter is limited to whether the authority correctly refused consent on the PS1 authorship ground.

limitations: Comparative only: a New Zealand determination used to test attachment format and content; it cannot establish Alberta performance or applicability.
